national_law.name: Ustawa o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczenstwa (Amendment)
national_law.formal_citation: Nowelizacja ustawy o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczenstwa

legislative_history.event: Sejm passed amendments to KSC Act

incident_reporting.early_warning: 24 hours from detection to sectoral CSIRT
incident_reporting.reporting_system: S46 system (deadline extended to 12 months for application)

management_liability.description: Board members bear individual financial and criminal liability. Responsibility cannot be delegated. Regular training mandatory for management and employees.

supply_chain_requirements.description: High-Risk Vendor (HRV) mechanism allows restricting ICT products/services from designated high-risk suppliers. Comprehensive supply chain review required.

csirt.name: CSIRT NASK
csirt.note: Civilian sector. CSIRT GOV (ABW) for government, CSIRT MON for military.

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual turnover

sources.title: Niebezpiecznik - Ustawa wdrazajaca NIS2 czeka na podpis Prezydenta

notes: Entities have 6 months to register as key/important entities
12-month deadline for risk management measure implementation
S46 incident reporting system with 12-month adoption deadline
